nodes.label: Two Local Invariants on One Declared Connected Application
nodes.statement: For the selected producer B and consumer A, the local invariant/range certificates actually hold under their separately declared admitted input families, with explicit state, time, mode, realization and validity bindings; availability of a proof schema alone is insufficient.
nodes.domain: One named actual P/I/K/D application, two selected component transition systems and their local certificate instances.
nodes.scope: Only the two declared components under the exact input/mode/realization scopes for which their local premises are discharged.
nodes.source_lineage: R171 schema-versus-instance amendment specialized to two local invariant certificates.
nodes.proof: Assumption package; no local certificate truth is inferred from schema availability or component labels.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Two true local certificates can fail after connection if the connector induces inputs or modes outside their scopes.

formal_contract_R172.object_domain: two selected actual component certificate instances
formal_contract_R172.quantifiers: every local state/input/mode covered by the two declared certificates
formal_contract_R172.bearer_time_signature: same named P/I/K/D application and fixed component realization maps
formal_contract_R172.purpose: Prevent theorem-schema availability from being substituted for actual component premises

nodes.label: Common Binding, Admitted Inputs, Projection and Agreement
nodes.statement: Compat_gamma jointly requires common actual P/I/K/D and synchronization binding, initial local-invariant and connector agreement, connector-induced inputs inside both certified input families, projection/refinement of every joint transition to both certified local transitions, and preservation of connector agreement.
nodes.domain: One named actual connected producer-consumer pair and one actual connector gamma.
nodes.scope: The declared joint transition relation, environment moves, synchronization convention and local certificate scopes only.
nodes.source_lineage: Standard invariant composition obligations made explicit for the R171 component-connection gap.
nodes.proof: Definition of one all-of compatibility predicate; Theorem R172-A uses every clause.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Type compatibility, common names or a drawn wire do not establish admitted-input preservation or actual shared-value agreement.

formal_contract_R172.object_domain: actual connector, component states/inputs and joint transitions
formal_contract_R172.quantifiers: every admitted joint initial state, environment move and successor
formal_contract_R172.bearer_time_signature: same P/I/K/D, realization maps, step/mode and connector occurrence
formal_contract_R172.purpose: Expose the exact additional premise needed for component-certificate composition

nodes.label: Compatible Local Certificates Imply the Declared Joint Invariant
nodes.statement: If both local invariant certificates hold and Compat_gamma holds, then S_gamma={(x_B,x_A):x_B in S_B, x_A in S_A, J_gamma(x_B,x_A)} is invariant under every admitted joint transition.
nodes.domain: The component and joint transition systems bound by the two premise nodes.
nodes.scope: Finite joint paths under the declared transition/input/mode/synchronization scope; no complete-organization conclusion.
nodes.source_lineage: Standard arbitrary-successor invariant proof, applied to the R171 composition question.
nodes.proof: Local invariants place both successor projections in S_B,S_A because induced inputs remain admitted and the joint step refines both local steps; interface preservation supplies J_gamma. Induct on path length.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: The theorem does not establish actual online use, complete organization, experiential unity, C1, B_min or an exclusive owner.

formal_contract_R172.object_domain: one actual connected component pair under the exact interface contract
formal_contract_R172.quantifiers: every finite admitted joint path and every successor on that path
formal_contract_R172.bearer_time_signature: same bound objects from both premises; no cross-target mixing
formal_contract_R172.purpose: Finish the bounded certificate-composition detour without promoting closure to experience

nodes.label: Standalone Invariants Fail Under an Out-of-Contract Connector
nodes.statement: For Boolean x_i'=u_i with standalone admitted u_i=0 and S_i={0}, both local certificates hold, but u_1=1-x_2,u_2=1-x_1 sends (0,0) to (1,1); local closure alone therefore does not entail joint closure.
nodes.domain: Two finite Boolean components and one connector.
nodes.scope: One exact counterexample to the general composition shortcut.
nodes.source_lineage: REVIEW-20261008-01 TE-QC-01, made an exact saved witness.
nodes.proof: Direct evaluation gives induced inputs (1,1) and successor (1,1), outside the certified product set.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: It identifies admitted-input compatibility as missing; it does not show all composition impossible.

formal_contract_R172.quantifiers: one explicit witness suffices to refute the unrestricted implication
formal_contract_R172.bearer_time_signature: abstract finite model only, not an actual apparatus
formal_contract_R172.purpose: Expose the exact interface premise omitted by the false shortcut

nodes.label: Live Representation-to-Action Use, Report Independent
nodes.statement: LiveUse_gamma(k,a|W) requires an actual connector occurrence, an occurring baseline consumer use, an admissible mediator/cut contrast that changes a before compensation while eligible background is fixed, passed delivery/time/realization/locality assumptions, and no report-defined role.
nodes.domain: One actual P/I/K/D, selected k/gamma/a occurrences, intervention family W and pre-compensation interval.
nodes.scope: A sufficient selected-role witness relative to the declared interventions and causal assumptions; not necessary for every action organization.
nodes.source_lineage: R166 W3-W5 refined to the cross-component interface selected in R172.
nodes.proof: Definition/application contract; only the all-true finite gate supports the selected status.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Invalid or null evidence stays unresolved under hidden redundancy or compensation; report equality cannot establish use.

formal_contract_R172.quantifiers: there exists a valid mediator/cut contrast and every fidelity/locality clause holds on the same instance
formal_contract_R172.bearer_time_signature: same P/I/K/D, realized occurrences, intervention window and eligible background
formal_contract_R172.purpose: Name the actual relation that differs between online and replayed action

nodes.label: Matched Baseline Action and Report Do Not Identify Online Use
nodes.statement: In L:k=b,a=k,r=ell(b) and Q:k=b,a=v,r=ell(b), baseline v=b makes (b,k,a,r) identical for both b values, while do(k=1-b) changes a only in L; no baseline-tuple decoder recovers the selected LiveUse label on {L,Q}.
nodes.domain: Two deterministic Boolean structural models, fixed replay tape and one admissible mediator intervention.
nodes.scope: Exact non-identification on the declared two-model class; not a model of any actual biological or AI system.
nodes.source_lineage: REVIEW-20261008-01 TE-QC-02 and R156/R166 bypass reasoning, refined to matched action plus report.
nodes.proof: Enumerate b=0,1. Baseline tuples agree; after do(k=1-b), live action is 1-b and replay action remains b while reports stay equal.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: Real systems can mix live/replay contributions or lack the intervention; the theorem only blocks inference from matched baseline records.

formal_contract_R172.quantifiers: both b values and the one declared intervention
formal_contract_R172.bearer_time_signature: abstract finite models; same baseline map and held-fixed b/v/report in the comparison
formal_contract_R172.purpose: Prove that output/report matching cannot replace actual-use evidence

nodes.label: Witnessed Online Body-Anchored Action Relation
nodes.statement: If R166's same-token frame installation, the R172 joint interface theorem and every LiveUse_gamma clause hold on one common P/I/K/D, then theta_EBA=Anchor AND Bind AND Compat_gamma AND LiveUse_gamma is supported as an actual selected relation during I.
nodes.scope: The selected relation and declared causal/realization scope only; no complete mechanism or necessity theorem.
nodes.source_lineage: R166 witnessed frame installation plus the R172 interface and online-use refinements.
nodes.proof: Bind all premises to one actual instance; R166 grounds Anchor/Bind, R172-A grounds the connected scope, and LiveUse supplies actual selected consumer dependence.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: A compatible safe connection without mediator dependence does not satisfy theta_EBA; any missing premise blocks the conclusion rather than proving absence.

formal_contract_R172.quantifiers: every conjunct holds simultaneously on one common instance
formal_contract_R172.bearer_time_signature: same P/I/K/D, connector, occurrences and intervention scope across all premises
formal_contract_R172.purpose: Return certificate composition to the positive actual organization needed by the main line

nodes.label: Online Body-Action Relation Has an Experiential Counterpart; Mineness Label Open
nodes.statement: On one identical admitted P/I/K/D/Phi/h, a grounded witnessed theta_EBA is transported by C1 to theta_EBA(h(b),h(k),h(a)) inside Phi; R157's semantic residual still blocks naming it familiar felt mineness, ownership or agency without independent B_min/F_O/F_A.
nodes.domain: One common actual C1 instance and one witnessed online body-action relation.
nodes.scope: A selected structural experiential relation only; not every experience, a scalar rank, a basal gate or an exclusive owner.
nodes.source_lineage: R157 coordinate transport/semantic residual and R159/R166 same-instance application, with R172's actual selected relation.
nodes.proof: Conjoin the grounded K-relations defining theta_EBA and apply ordinary formula preservation under the same C1 isomorphism; retain the external-vocabulary nonuniqueness proof.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: External relabeling can preserve every K-fact; no report, physical test or map check derives C1 or validates the familiar label.

formal_contract_R172.object_domain: one actual and experiential selected relation on the same C1 instance
formal_contract_R172.quantifiers: every common instance satisfying all premises; familiar labels require an additional independent bridge
formal_contract_R172.bearer_time_signature: same P/I/K/D/Phi/h and correctly sorted h-images; no cross-token or cross-session substitution
formal_contract_R172.purpose: Give the positive experience-internal action-coordinate explanation without an extra owner or report gate

nodes.label: Compare Biological and Artificial Online Use Only After Actual Grounding
nodes.statement: Biological and artificial processes may be compared on theta_EBA only after their own actual realization, interface, LiveUse and common-signature obligations are discharged. Matched output/report does not establish theta_EBA, while shared theta_EBA does not establish complete-organizational or experiential identity.
nodes.domain: Named biological/artificial actual tokens and their separately grounded selected relations.
nodes.scope: One selected cross-substrate organizational coordinate; no consciousness-status or richness ranking conclusion.
nodes.source_lineage: R172 live/replay non-identification plus conditional experience-internal selected-coordinate result.
nodes.proof: Use the paired-model witness to block output/report inference and the selected-coordinate theorem to type what an actually grounded comparison can support.
nodes.counterexamples_and_limits: The same task transcript can coexist with live/replay differences; the same selected relation can coexist with other complete-organization differences.

formal_contract_R172.quantifiers: each token discharges every premise independently before comparison
formal_contract_R172.bearer_time_signature: separate P/I/K/D/Phi/h bindings with an explicitly justified common comparison signature
formal_contract_R172.purpose: State what the result teaches about biological/AI organization beyond output matching
